leadText: Volume 18 is the eighteenth volume published by VIZ Media compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. As part of VIZ Media's Pokémon Black and White series, the chapters in this volume have been collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures.

Volume 18 is the eighteenth volume published by VIZ Media compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. As part of VIZ Media's Pokémon Black and White series, the chapters in this volume have been collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures.
